messages.subject: Hierarchical variance partitioning
parts:
Hello group, 
I have a question I thought of recently concerning hierarchical occupancy models. I've developed a model that separates the landscape level anthropogenic disturbance from point level habitat. I would like to calculate the amount of total variance explained at each level, but a Google search yielded no resources (literature or otherwise) that seem to address this issue specifically. 

I'll admit there may be some highly technical statistical literature that is beyond my ken. Before I start the time consuming process of digging through literature and textbooks, I am hoping someone in the group might point me to some resources they know of. Any help would be greatly appreciated. 

Thanks, 

--
